Finished effect can be seen http://whoaverse.com/v/tsg here, titled [tags] Lets test tegas. This would not be possible without /u/Atko implementing the title tag, so shower him in upvotes, won't you? :P

If you want to tag posts AND have a nice "flair" next to them, you can do this.

This is the css: 

[title^="[tags]"]:before{
 display:inline-block;
 content:"Tags test";
 margin:4px;
 padding-left:4px;
 padding-right:4px;
 border:1px solid #555555;
 border-radius:3px;
 background:#F0F0F0;
 color:#333333;
}

We'll focus on this first: 

[title^="[tags]"]:before{

This detects any elements that have the "title" attribute, with the [] brackets, and then finds if the beginning on this attribute has [tags] in it - the beginning is denoted by ^= (*= means anywhere), and the "" quotations tell it what to look for. Finally, the :before selector tells it not to style the link, but the actual space before it - inserting content. If you want to style the link, remove the :before selector. 

content:"Tags test";

This tells the css what to insert. Again, if you don't want to insert content, don't include it.

The remaining CSS is just stuff to style the inserted content to make the tag stand out more.
